svg.text: Azure GraphRAG on Databases — end-to-end architecture
Plain-English questions over a 20-table mutual fund database. Tables are graph nodes, joins are hops. Every answer = a table + commentary + the exact, checked, read-only SQL.
① BUILD TIME · run once, then after changes
config/ models · agent · metrics (approved business definitions)
tests/ 66 tests, stage by stage, against the real Azure services
each: 100% of values match, no foreign key declared
Azure App Service · Linux · Python 3.13 · B1
startup.sh → uvicorn api.main:app · 1 worker · health check /health
1 · guard_input — Prompt Shields: block prompt attacks
2 · understand — rewrite · intent · period · metrics · data needed
4 · select_tables — metrics + each data need + table search
6 · write_sql — one SELECT: given tables, joins, definitions
8 · run_sql — READ ONLY · 15 s timeout · 5,000-row cap
9 · summarise — trim the result for the model
11 · remember — keep question + SQL for follow-ups
↺ check_sql or run_sql fails → back to write_sql with the error (at most 2 retries)
③ Azure Database for PostgreSQL · Flexible Server · one server, two databases
PostgreSQL 16 · Burstable B1ms · Central India · azure.extensions = VECTOR, AGE · shared_preload_libraries ⊃ age · sslmode=require
mf_data — business data, read-only to the agent · 20 tables · 1,132,667 rows
agent_meta — what the agent knows about mf_data
